# cloudflare_email_auth_dmarc_report (Resource)

Accepted Permissions

- `Email Security DMARC Reports Read`
- `Email Security DMARC Reports Write`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_email_auth_dmarc_report" "example_email_auth_dmarc_report" {
  zone_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  enabled = true
  skip_wizard = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (String) Identifier.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable DMARC reports for this zone. When enabling, the API ensures the DMARC RUA record exists in DNS.
- `skip_wizard` (Boolean) Skip the DMARC setup wizard.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp
- `id` (String) Identifier.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification timestamp
- `rua_prefix` (String) Prefix for DMARC RUA addresses (32-char hex string).
- `status` (String) DMARC configuration status. Omitted by the API when DMARC is correctly configured.
Available values: "missing-dmarc-report", "multiple-dmarc-reports", "missing-dmarc-rua", "cname-on-dmarc-record", "unauthorized-reporting-domain".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_email_auth_dmarc_report.example '<zone_id>'
```
